failure_condition: The same claim_id appears on more than one row in the claims extract.
escalation: Hold the batch. Raise a P2 ticket with the interface team; do not release to the payer until the resend is collapsed to one row.

failure_condition: Two or more distinct claim_ids share patient_id, provider_npi, date_of_service, cpt_code and billed_amount.
escalation: Route to the Charge Entry lead for clinical confirmation before submission. Duplicate billing is a compliance exposure, not just a data issue.

failure_condition: The same claim_id is posted more than once against the same check/EFT number for the same paid amount.
escalation: Freeze posting for the affected check. Notify Cash Posting supervisor same day; reversal must be booked before month-end close.

failure_condition: A remittance line references a claim_id that does not exist in the claims extract.
escalation: Return to the Cash Posting queue. If the claim cannot be located within 2 business days, escalate to the payer as an unidentified payment.

failure_condition: A claim carries status PAID in the billing system but no remittance line was received.
escalation: Route to A/R Follow-up. Status is unsupported by cash; correct the claim status or locate the missing 835.

failure_condition: billed_amount <> paid_amount + patient_responsibility + contractual_adjustment, beyond a USD 0.01 rounding tolerance.
escalation: Route to Payment Variance analyst with the claim and remittance evidence. Anything above USD 500 goes to the Payer Relations lead the same day.

failure_condition: Total paid on a claim exceeds the billed charge.
escalation: Report to Refunds/Credit Balance immediately. Overpayments carry a statutory refund clock; do not hold in a working file.

failure_condition: Remitted allowed_amount is more than 10% below the contracted expected_allowed_amount on an adjudicated (non-denied) claim.
escalation: Bundle by payer and route to Contract Management for an underpayment appeal. Escalate at 25 claims or USD 5,000, whichever comes first.

failure_condition: payer_id on the claim is blank or absent from the payer master.
escalation: Return to the Enrollment/Payer Maintenance owner. Claim cannot be routed or reconciled until the payer is mapped.

failure_condition: provider_npi is not 10 numeric digits or fails the Luhn check digit over the 80840 prefix.
escalation: Return to Provider Data Management. A claim with an invalid NPI will reject at the clearinghouse.

failure_condition: Remittance dated before the date of service, claim submitted before the date of service, or a date of service in the future.
escalation: Route to the source-system owner. Recurring breaks in one feed indicate a mapping or timezone defect and go to the interface team.

failure_condition: patient_id, date_of_service, cpt_code, icd10_code or billed_amount is blank, malformed, zero or negative.
escalation: Return to Charge Entry for correction. Claim is not submittable and must not be counted in reconciliation totals.
